codes.report_not_accepted: Caller did not accept the report digest.
codes.coverage_gap: No eligible commitment establishes coverage in part of the required interval.
codes.scope_insufficient: A commitment does not cover the relevant policy scope.
codes.statement_obligation: A commitment does not satisfy a required support condition.
codes.missing_usage: An inventory entry cannot be resolved to typed usage.
codes.forbidden_exposure: Accepted occurrence is forbidden in the required history.
codes.clock_incompatible: Accepted timing premises have no compatible timeline.
codes.clock_unresolved: The accepted timing premises could not be checked completely.
codes.possible_exposure: A present forbidden occurrence may fall in the required history.
codes.capture_challenge: An accepted challenge certainly overlaps a matching capture commitment.
